units.source_text: 阿民听完婆婆的哭诉，心里想如果自己继续坚持的话，也委实不够通情达理。

en.t: After listening to her mother-in-law's tearful complaint, Amin thought that if she kept insisting, she really would be unreasonable.

units.source_text: 尽管放弃了养蚕的想法，却依然要坚持种植桑田。

en.t: Although she gave up the idea of raising silkworms, she still insisted on planting mulberry fields.

units.source_text: 阿民心有不服的看着阿住，以讽刺的语气说：“那好吧！

en.t: Amin looked at Azhu with resentment and said in a sarcastic tone, "Fine then!

units.source_text: 反正种植桑田的事情，只需要我一个人就行了。”

en.t: After all, when it comes to planting the mulberry fields, I can do it all by myself."
